notes: No seed website; the county site is https://www.co.roberts.tx.us/ (Elections page page/roberts.elections). No Clarity site (elections.json 404). The two primary result files are image scans (RICOH copier) with no text layer; pages 1-2 of the Republican file were read visually. Nothing for the 2024 general or the 2026 runoff results is posted. Check 3 pending (wayback-data branch not found on origin). Rule 43 applied 2026-10-02 (normalize-4): 2026_primary LATER kept, county_totals_first_seen 2026-03-03 20:13 CT.

2024_general.fact: No 2024 general results are posted on the county Elections page (only a 'General Election Ballots' file). Check 3 pending.

2026_primary.fact: Under 'PRIMARY ELECTION DAY RESULTS': 'REPUBLICAN RESULTS' (12 pages) and 'DEMOCRAT RESULTS' (11 pages), scanned 'Republican Primary Cumulative Results ... ROBERTS COUNTY, TEXAS PRIMARY ELECTION 3/3/2026 ... Unofficial Results', county totals by Absentee/Early/Election Day (read visually; printed run time not legible at scan resolution). PDF CreationDate Wed Mar 4 01:16:20 and 01:32:07 2026 UTC; Last-Modified Thu, 05 Mar 2026 14:12:08 GMT (Republican) and Wed, 04 Mar 2026 18:57:46 GMT (Democratic), both after election night. No precinct-by-precinct report is posted (precinct numbers never published online as far as the site shows). Rule 43: county totals first seen 2026-03-03 20:13 CT in REPUBLICAN RESULTS.pdf (printed 'Run Time 8:13 PM Run Date 03/03/2026', read at 300 dpi; DEMOCRAT RESULTS.pdf Run Time 8:14 PM 03/03/2026; scans created 2026-03-04 01:16 and 01:32 UTC; no precinct report posted).

2026_runoff.fact: The runoff section lists the notice, sample ballot, early-vote and election-day rosters only; no results files. Check 3 pending.
